{"file_text": "from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user_by_email

def test_handle_get_user_by_email():
    # Success
    status, user = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "ada@example.com"})
    assert status == 200
    assert user["email"] == "ada@example.com"

    # Not found
    status, error = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "notfound@example.com"})
    assert status == 404
    assert error == {"error": "not found"}

    # Invalid email
    status, error = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": "invalid"})
    assert status == 400
    assert error == {"error": "invalid email"}
    
    # Missing email
    status, error = handle_get_user_by_email({})
    assert status == 400
    assert error == {"error": "invalid email"}

    # Non-string email
    status, error = handle_get_user_by_email({"email": 123})
    assert status == 400
    assert error == {"error": "invalid email"}
", "file_path": "tests/test_handlers.py"}
